goal: Experiment 6 stage S1 for trial __TRIAL_ID__: infer the unresolved distinctions of the raw task package (with latent-structure features) and estimate per-family observed-value components; produce typed DistinctionSpec and value-estimate artifacts for the deterministic downstream pipeline.

nodes.instructions: Read every file in package/ plus contract.json, the schemas, and this harness. Acquire evidence only; infer nothing yet.
nodes.why_necessary: Distinction inference is a function of the raw task semantics; the evidence state must be acquired as a distinct causal step.

nodes.instructions: Write distinctions.json conforming to distinction-spec-schema.json: the unresolved distinctions with admissibility constraints, evidence-requirement references, dependencies, and latent-structure features.
nodes.why_necessary: The latent inference under test: topology-relevant structure must be derived from raw semantics, not from prefilled features.

nodes.instructions: Write value-estimates.json conforming to value-estimates-schema.json: predicted delta_e, redundancy, and governance_risk per candidate family, with rationales.
nodes.why_necessary: Predicted-value components are model-mediated estimates; they must be serialized into a typed artifact before deterministic utility arithmetic and ranking.

nodes.instructions: Re-read both artifacts against their schemas; record the structural outcome in the ledger. Non-authoritative: deterministic root validation governs.
nodes.why_necessary: The contract requires a verify primitive in any Write-holding topology; the author must not silently certify its own artifacts.

nodes.instructions: Write spec-summary.json ({task_id, distinction_count, families_estimated}) and finalize execution-ledger.jsonl. Do not emit a complete event.
nodes.why_necessary: Mandated return locus; without it the inference never re-enters the governed boundary.

ledger_contract.schema: normalized formal event schema: one JSON object per line with event_id, label, actor, timestamp, artifact_refs, metadata; node executions carry metadata.completes_node
ledger_contract.forbidden: no complete event; no create/act events
ledger_contract.optional_events: additional non-authority events with actor 'creator' permitted as governance self-loops; tau lines permitted with metadata.reason
